title: ActionFunctionArgs
summary: Request arguments supplied to a server action.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Aliases LoaderFunctionArgs. request carries the mutation method and body; params identifies the matched route; signal cancels work when the request is superseded or disconnected.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Read the request body once. Validate user input before mutating application state. Return plain data or data(...) for results and redirect(...) for navigation; a fetcher action result is exposed on that fetcher.
